textElements.rationale: The one hook line. Starts at 1.8 = 0.2s after the shot at 1.6 begins, and deliberately after both hook shots (0.0-0.7 and 0.7-1.6) so the first two seconds are pure footage before any title card. y=0.155 clears the 9:16 top-10% UI shelf and sits well above the centred face. 2 tokens over 1.8s is far past the 0.8s reading floor; ends at 3.6, before the 4.2 cut.

Format promise under the hook line - tells a cold viewer this is a jump-cut top-3, not a ramble. Different position (y=0.235 vs 0.155) and different animation (fade vs pop) so nothing is stacked or repeated; 4 tokens over 1.5s clears the reading floor; ends at 3.6 with the title, before the 4.2 cut.

Number badge for point 1, 0.2s after the 6.4 shot start (the point marker). Upper-left at x=0.16/y=0.165 keeps it off the centred face and out of the top-10% shelf; scale-in reads as a stamp. Ends 8.4, before the 9.0 cut.

Number badge for point 2 at the 15.0 chapter change (+0.2s), same locked position as '01' so the series reads as a list. Animation switches scale -> pop to satisfy the distinct-animation rule without moving the badge. Ends 17.0, before the 17.2 cut.

Number badge for the final point, 0.2s after the 30.0 shot start - the exact frame the music drops out, so the elastic overshoot is the only punctuation left once the bed is gone. Held to just 1.0s (vs 1.8s for 01/02) because phase 3 cuts every ~1s and the badge must clear the 31.2 cut; 1 token is above the 0.8s reading floor.

Landing card on the 3.8s held outro shot, 0.4s after the shot begins at 41.2 - closes the numbered list so the edit lands instead of trailing off. Centred at y=0.165, clear of the face and the top-10% shelf; fade-out completes at 44.2, 0.8s before the 45.0 end. Fourth distinct animation (pop/fade/scale/elastic/rise).

audioDecisions.rationale: Low bed under points 01 and 02 only (0.0-30.0). The requested track 'audio/21 Savage - a lot ft. J. Cole.mp3' is not present in the footage graph - video-1 is the only canonical sourceVideoId - and inventing an id would render silent and invalidate the plan, so per the rule 'use a video's own audio only if there is no audio file' the bed is drawn from video-1's non-speech tail (410.0-416.4) and laid at 0.22, well under the dialogue, which stays at full level throughout.

Music dropped ENTIRELY on the final point per the request: from 30.0 (the exact frame the '03' chapter opens and the brightness hit lands) to 45.0 there is no bed at all, only the speaker's dry voice, so the last idea lands on silence instead of trailing off under music.

One-shot transient under the 'THE TOP 3' title punch at 1.8 - timed to the title-card trigger, the first beat after the two hook shots. Kept at 0.35 and inside the music-bed region so it never touches the dry final point.

One-shot transient on the 15.0 chapter change into point 02 - with hard cuts only and zero rendered transitions, this plus the 1.14 contrast snap is what marks the chapter boundary. Last SFX of the edit; nothing is added after 30.0 so the final point stays dry.

captionTemplate.rationale: Open captions burned in for the whole 45s, generated from video-1's own speech so the speaker's original wording is preserved exactly (no rewriting, no paraphrase). Word-by-word highlight at 0.1s per token keeps the eye on the current word, which is what makes a jump-cut teaching short readable without sound-on context. y=0.74 sits below the centred face region and above the 9:16 bottom-20% UI shelf; 4-word lines at 46px stay inside the safe width after the cover crop. carryAcrossCut=true lets a caption line span a jump cut when a sentence runs over it, so no sentence is visually chopped mid-clause.

metadata.rationale: 45s 9:16 teaching cut built as a numbered top-3 from podcast #1.mp4 (video-1, 416.4s, single analyzed segment video-1-seg-0, b-roll/medium motion, conf .50). Spine: 1.6s cold-open tease (two shots, strongest lines pulled forward from 3:07 and 5:56) -> title card -> POINT 01 block 1.6-15.0 (setup 1.6-6.4, point 6.4-15.0) -> POINT 02 block 15.0-30.0 -> POINT 03 block 30.0-45.0 with a 3.8s held landing. Point blocks land at 13.4s and 15.0s apart, inside the requested one-point-every-12-15s window, and each block opens with 2.2-4.8s of setup so the idea reads with zero prior context. Every cut is a jump cut to a new source position inside the same speaker frame (filler/pause removal) - no rendered transitions anywhere because the request explicitly says hard cuts only, so plan.transitions[] is intentionally empty. Rhythm: ASL 1.88s (phase 1) -> 1.36s (phase 2, 73%) -> 1.02s excluding the landing hold (phase 3, 54%), with the 3.8s hold longer than any prior shot (max 2.6s). Wording is untouched: all audio is the source dialogue track at natural speed, and the only speed change in the edit is the ramp on the decontextualised hook fragment (segment 1, source 356.4-357.21 = 0.81s window) whose four keyframes now sit strictly inside that window at 0, 0.30, 0.50 and 0.78 with pitch correction, so no teaching line is time-stretched and no keyframe falls outside the source range. Captions: captionTemplate drives a verbatim burned-in open-caption layer (word-by-word karaoke highlight, y=0.74, clear of the 9:16 bottom-20% UI shelf and clear of the centred face) generated from video-1's own speech so the speaker's exact wording is preserved; caption lines are allowed to carry across a jump cut where a sentence spans two shots rather than cutting the sentence. AUDIO NOTE: the requested bed 'audio/21 Savage - a lot ft. J. Cole.mp3' is not present in the footage graph (the only canonical sourceVideoId is video-1), and inventing an id would render silent, so per the rule 'use a video's own audio only if there is no audio file' the low bed is sourced from video-1's own non-speech tail (410.0-416.4) at volume 0.22 under points 01-02 only, and is dropped ENTIRELY at 30.0 for the final point (explicit silence decision 30.0-45.0) exactly as requested - the last point lands on dry voice. Face-safety: this is a talking head throughout, so the accent palette is grade/brightness/contrast/saturation/vignette/grain/tonal only - zero glitch, zero chromatic aberration, zero blur on any frame containing the speaker, and all camera moves are held at 0.22-0.40 intensity.
